question: What Advice Would You Give A 26-Year-Old?

answers.text: You got time. Don't put pressure on yourself.
Follow your dreams, maybe Work Hard. I've got a close to 26 year old in my life right now. Yeah, I would just say try and try and be better each day.
Stay away from drugs. Finish school. Get educated. Try to do the right things.
Take it easy. Eat very good
Just keep going. You’re still young by the way I’ve seen people do things at the age of 40, you’re still a baby still a little kid so keep going!
